recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片幾乎全為脂肪、只剩零星細胞，符合再生不良性貧血 (aplastic anemia)；B 圖 CT 可見前縱膈腫塊；C 圖為上皮細胞與淋巴球混合、伴纖維束的胸腺瘤 (thymoma)，三者合看提示胸腺瘤相關骨髓衰竭 (Good syndrome)。
features: Panel A: bone marrow biopsy almost entirely replaced by adipocytes with only scattered small cells between fat spaces; bony trabeculae at edges
Panel A: no identifiable clusters of erythroid, myeloid or megakaryocytic precursors in this field
Panel B: contrast CT at the level of the aortic arch showing a small soft-tissue nodule in the anterior mediastinum measured about 15.9 × 32.3 mm
Panel C: thymoma with sheets of small lymphocytes admixed with plump spindle to epithelioid cells, separated by eosinophilic fibrous bands
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly hypocellular marrow composed almost entirely of adipose tissue, with only scattered lymphocytes and stromal cells and no appreciable trilineage hematopoiesis; there is no infiltrative process in this field. A chest CT demonstrates an anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass. The resected mediastinal lesion shows a lymphocyte-rich epithelial neoplasm with spindled areas and fibrous septa, consistent with thymoma (mixed type A/B per the case). Together with pancytopenia, these findings are consistent with thymoma-associated aplastic anemia; immunoglobulin levels and B-cell counts should be assessed for Good syndrome.

ddx.vs: Hypocellular MDS retains dysplastic megakaryocytes or clusters of immature precursors and often shows increased CD34+ cells or a clonal karyotype, none of which is seen in this fatty marrow.
PRCA shows selective absence of erythroid precursors with preserved granulopoiesis and megakaryocytes, whereas this marrow lacks all three lineages.
Morphology is identical, so exclusion requires chromosome breakage, telomere length and germline testing.
PNH is separated by flow cytometric detection of GPI-anchor-deficient (FLAER-negative) clones, not by marrow morphology.
